audit_scope: v0.9 frozen H1 invoked by v0.10 origin-sequential shadow replay

components.name: same-meter 30-day off/on current baseline
components.availability_reason: baseline is called by replay_meter for each evaluable meter-day
components.score_contribution: indirect: supplies off/on baseline and separation to activation and phase; no standalone H1 weight

components.name: fixed daytime active-window gate
components.availability_reason: replay_meter applies 09:00-17:00 and activation >= 0.20 before H1
components.score_contribution: gate only; excludes rows before feature_case and decide
components.actual_ami_coverage: all five target-meter replay streams; no municipal sunrise join

components.name: current-derived activation evidence
components.availability_reason: feature_case computes normalized activation from measured current and same-meter baseline
components.actual_ami_coverage: 5/5 target meters have measured current; B-L-13 is single-channel

components.name: continuous-on duration and current-derived persistence
components.availability_reason: feature_case builds duration and persistence_evidence from activation values
components.decision_stage: H1 stage A and evidence gate
components.actual_ami_coverage: 7/7 v0.10 evidence cases; five anonymized target meters

components.name: native measured-channel selectivity
components.availability_reason: phase_value is computed only when at least two native current channels exist
components.decision_stage: H1 stage A and evidence gate
components.actual_ami_coverage: 4/5 target meters have three measured current channels; 6/7 evidence cases

components.name: short-duration/transient contradiction penalty
components.availability_reason: duration <= 15 minutes sets transient and stage_a applies the penalty
components.score_contribution: stage_a penalty -0.20; transient contradiction can reduce gate score
components.decision_stage: H1 stage A and evidence gate

components.name: fixed weighted evidence gate
components.availability_reason: decide invokes evidence for architecture H1 and requires threshold plus at least two families
components.score_contribution: family weights solar 0.30, persistence 0.25, load 0.20, phase 0.15, policy 0.10; H1 does not renormalize
components.decision_stage: H1 specificity gate and final action
components.actual_ami_coverage: persistence 7/7 and phase 6/7 evidence cases; only current-derived families supplied

components.name: 30-day warm-up and history-quality state
components.availability_reason: replay_meter marks warm-up and insufficient history/gap rows before H1
components.score_contribution: state gate only; no H1 score contribution

components.name: solar/daylight/geographic context
components.availability_reason: solar_evidence is null, near_solar_boundary is false, and v0.10 marks solar unavailable
components.decision_stage: not available as an evidence family

components.name: municipal rated-load/load-mismatch evidence
components.availability_reason: load_mismatch and load_evidence are null; contract power is not joined into the H1 case
components.decision_stage: not available as an evidence family

components.name: municipal policy/allowed-partial-operation context
components.availability_reason: policy_evidence is null and normal_partial_policy is false; no municipal policy join
components.decision_stage: not available as an evidence family

components.name: municipal cabinet-to-meter mapping
components.availability_reason: ami_cabinet_mappings.csv is header-only and v0.10 forbids a cabinet join
components.score_contribution: none; operational metadata is not an H1 input

components.name: H3 inspection queue optimizer
components.availability_reason: queue_score requires architecture H3 while the frozen call uses H1
components.score_contribution: none in H1; queue formula is not invoked
